title: Post-processing Private Synthetic Data for Improving Utility on Selected Measures
reasoning: The paper primarily focuses on a technical solution for improving the utility of synthetic data while preserving privacy. While it acknowledges the importance of addressing 'algorithmic bias,' 'disparate impact,' and 'fairness' in generated data, these mentions are in the context of potential applications or broader implications of synthetic data quality, not as a core component of evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morals, or religious concepts themselves.
